milestone.describes: An Easy round is running: the plane crosses the top of the screen, a parachutist falls, the boat sits on the water and the score and lives HUD is drawn.

steps.expect: The title screen with the "What's New?" dialog over it. Allow about 32 s — this app is slow to reach it.

steps.from: title with the What's New? dialog
steps.expect: The main menu: New Game, Challenges, High Scores, Themes, Extras, How To Play, News.
The round starts after about 18 s: plane, falling parachutist, boat on the water, score and lives HUD.

notes: Coordinates are client coordinates for the 320x480 portrait window.

Every wait here is long and each one matters — 32 s to the title, 12 s after OK, 16 s after New Game, and about 18 s before the round actually starts. A replay that cuts them short taps an earlier screen and looks like broken input.
The "What's New?" dialog is a first-run screen. If a save exists it may not appear, in which case the OK tap lands on the title harmlessly and the main menu is already up.
This was verified by three captures six seconds apart being three distinct images, compared by SHA-256 rather than by eye.
